correctness.rationale: For any nonempty S subset (0,1), all leaf-formula values are uniformly one of 0,s,1: the Gödel operations preserve the ordered triple, and both modal operations are constants at terminal leaves. Root modal truth is the infimum or supremum of these leaf roles, hence depends only on a=inf S,b=sup S. The formulas Box p and Diamond p recover the pair. With 0<a<b<1, closure gives at most 3*4=12 leaf/root semantic signatures, and each of the twelve has an explicit displayed formula; star_checker.py independently verifies closure and representatives. Box p and Diamond p require their extrema to be attained, while attainment of both endpoints witnesses every formula by the uniform-role lemma. Rational open-interval leaves and their endpoint completion have equal exact root values and identical leaf truth-one theories, hence equal global theories and all local consequence relations despite different witnessedness. The mathematical proof is by structural induction and complete quantification over formulas, not inference from finite experiments.

Earlier finite-depth witness tests and generic frame regrading theorems do not furnish this implication without the new uniform-leaf proof. originality.rationale: Relevant full primary materials define witnessed Gödel-Kripke semantics and develop sound/complete systems, but the inspected definitions, main results, proofs and conclusions do not classify a fixed-valued star family by its infimum/supremum or count its twelve formula signatures, nor identify an explicitly same-local-consequence witnessed/unwitnessed pair. Known finite-frame regrading results do not imply preservation upon addition of non-attained valuation limits; finite-height witnessing cutoffs detect witnesses meta-semantically, unlike the modal-language undefinability here. Literature and mathematical-record searches found no statement implying the complete theorem. Priority beyond inspected sources remains uncertain.
residual_risks: A pre-2026 result may express the endpoint-completion observation as Gödel-term normal forms, algebraic compactifications or logical nondefinability of attained infima without using the word witnessing.

Petr Hájek, On witnessed models in fuzzy logic (2007), was located but only an abstract was accessible; it concerns quantified fuzzy predicate models and cannot be asserted not to contain an analogous lemma.
Search results do not establish uniqueness, and only relevant sections of the cited primary full texts, not every old paper or cited reference, have been compared.

value.rationale: The 2026 sources explicitly motivate full witnessing and axiomatizations of its modal consequences. The exact endpoint normal form gives a complete finite (twelve-signature) algebra of all formulas, rather than a mere bounded example. The sharp witness-attainment iff endpoints belong to S and the pair with identical all-depth root values and identical local entailment distinguish the semantic model property from the theorem system it determines, a substantive limitation on expressibility. No paper-sized downstream application is needed for this natural structural classification; it is mathematically motivated by the newly foregrounded witnessed-model semantics.
